title: TodayPanel
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column and Row inside MonarchSectionCard, with MonarchAgendaList, MonarchCheckboxRow, MonarchBadge and MonarchText
summary: A person's day on a home screen: MonarchSectionCard titled "Today" with today's agenda (MonarchAgendaList for one day) above the tasks due today, overdue first, each a MonarchCheckboxRow with an "Overdue" badge where it applies.
whenToUse: At the top of a home or dashboard screen that answers "what do I have today?" for one person.
whenNotToUse: For several days of events, use MonarchAgendaList on its own. For a full task list with filters, use a list screen.
api: MonarchSectionCard(title = "Today", meta = date) { MonarchText(text = "Schedule", style = MonarchTextStyle.Label); MonarchAgendaList(events, modifier = Modifier.height(…), from = today, days = 1, today = today); MonarchText(text = "Due today", style = MonarchTextStyle.Label); tasks.sortedByDescending { it.overdue }.forEach { Row { MonarchCheckboxRow(checked, onCheckedChange, label = title, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), description = detail); if (overdue) MonarchBadge(text = "Overdue", tone = MonarchTone.Danger) } } }

options.name: MonarchSectionCard.meta
options.description: Today's date, written with DateUtils.formatDateTime(context, today, FORMAT_SHOW_WEEKDAY or FORMAT_SHOW_DATE).

options.name: MonarchSectionCard.state
options.description: Loading, Empty or Error while the day loads or fails, with errorMessage and onRetry.

options.name: events
options.description: Today's meetings, shown by MonarchAgendaList with from = today and days = 1. Leave the schedule out for a person without a calendar.

options.name: tasks
options.description: Tasks due today and overdue ones, overdue first; each is a MonarchCheckboxRow (title as label, project as description).

options.name: MonarchBadge
options.description: After an overdue task, so overdue is said in words, not by color.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchSectionCard with state = Error, errorMessage and onRetry.

states.name: nothing today
states.description: MonarchSectionCard with state = Empty and emptyMessage "Nothing scheduled and nothing due today.", or a line of text.

appearance: MonarchSectionCard's surface, MonarchAgendaList's day, checkbox rows in default text with muted descriptions, and the danger badge, all in their own appearance in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web TodayPanel is one component with the agenda beside the tasks on wide screens. On a phone the two stack, so Android composes existing parts in a MonarchSectionCard: the agenda, then the tasks. The web's built-in strings, task links (href), lead and meta slots and maxTasks with a "N more" link are the app's choices here: open a task from its row's own action, and add a MonarchLink to the full list. MonarchAgendaList is lazy, so it gets a fixed height inside a scrolling screen. iOS shares the recipe approach.
accessibility: The card title and the section titles (Schedule, Due today) are headings, so TalkBack users can jump between them.
Each task is one MonarchCheckboxRow: one TalkBack element with the checkbox role, its title and detail, and a 48dp row.
Overdue is a badge in words after the task, not a color.
Events are read by MonarchAgendaList with their times.
edgeCases: Keep the task list short on a home screen and link to the full list.
Overdue tasks come first, then the others in the app's order.
Give MonarchAgendaList a fixed height inside a scrolling screen.
